Style: cells: flat coloured cells. edges: glowing borders. cracked: shattered glass shards. stained: stained-glass look.
Jitter: Seed placement: 0 = regular grid, 1 = fully random.
Speed: Drift speed of the seeds. 0 = static.
Motion: Distance the seeds wander. 0 = no drift.
Borderwidth: Width of cell borders in pixels.
Glow: Strength of the glow along cell edges.
Edgetint: How much the edge glow takes colour from the input rather than Edgecolor (0-1).
Displace: Cracked style: how far each shard is displaced.
Linewidth: Width of the Delaunay lines in pixels.
Densitymode: What seed density follows: uniform, bright areas, dark areas or edges of the input.
Densityamount: How strongly Densitymode concentrates seeds. 0 = uniform.
Look: original: the internal demo source keeps its colours. mono: demo source becomes black, bone-white and grey. Only affects the demo shown with in1 unconnected.
Accent: Amount (0-1) of red accent tinted onto one object of the demo source (in1 unconnected). Only affects the demo.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
